arxiv-2211-12456.creator: Emre Yolcu, Marijn J. H. Heule
arxiv-2211-12456.description: Abstract We study the complexity of proof systems augmenting resolution with inference rules that allow, given a formula Γ \Gamma in conjunctive normal form, deriving clauses that are not necessarily logically implied by Γ \Gamma but whose addition to Γ \Gamma preserves satisfiability.

arxiv-2301-04589.title: Memory Augmented Large Language Models are Computationally Universal
arxiv-2301-04589.creator: Dale Schuurmans
arxiv-2301-04589.description: Abstract We show that transformer-based large language models are computationally universal when augmented with an external memory. Any deterministic language model that conditions on strings of bounded length is equivalent to a finite automaton, hence computationally limited. However, augmenting such models with a read-write memory creates the possibility of processing arbitrarily large inputs and, potentially, simulating any algorithm.

arxiv-2303-11848.title: Dens-PU: PU Learning with Density-Based Positive Labeled Augmentation
arxiv-2303-11848.creator: Vasileios Sevetlidis, George Pavlidis, Spyridon Mouroutsos, Antonios Gasteratos
arxiv-2303-11848.description: Abstract This study proposes a novel approach for solving the PU learning problem based on an anomaly-detection strategy. Latent encodings extracted from positive-labeled data are linearly combined to acquire new samples. These new samples are used as embeddings to increase the density of positive-labeled data and, thus, define a boundary that approximates the positive class.

arxiv-2401-10477.title: Dynamical Property of Black Hole Matter
arxiv-2401-10477.creator: C.S. Lam
arxiv-2401-10477.description: Abstract Matter loses its original characteristics after entering a black hole, thus becoming a new kind of (black hole) matter. The property of this new matter cannot be measured experimentally, but some of it can be deduced theoretically from the Einstein equations and the conservation laws which it must still satisfy.

arxiv-2404-07003.title: An adaptive acceleration scheme for phase-field fatigue computations
arxiv-2404-07003.creator: Jonas Heinzmann, Pietro Carrara, Marreddy Ambati, Amir Mohammad Mirzaei, Laura De Lorenzis
arxiv-2404-07003.description: Abstract Phase-field models of fatigue are capable of reproducing the main phenomenology of fatigue behavior. However, phase-field computations in the high-cycle fatigue regime are prohibitively expensive due to the need to resolve spatially the small length scale inherent to phase-field models and temporally the loading history for several millions of cycles.

arxiv-2404-10036.title: Late-time X-ray Observations of the Jetted Tidal Disruption Event AT2022cmc: The Relativistic Jet Shuts Off Facilities: Chandra X-ray Observatory

pmc-10668802.title: Identification of Vibrio metschnikovii and Vibrio injensis Isolated from Leachate Ponds: Characterization of Their Antibiotic Resistance and Virulence-Associated Genes
pmc-10668802.creator: Aura Falco, Miguel Ángel Villaquirán-Muriel, José David Gallo Pérez, Alejandra Mondragón-Quiguanas, Carlos Aranaga, Adriana Correa
pmc-10668802.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). This study aimed to evaluate the antibiotic resistance of 22 environmental Vibrio metschnikovii isolates and 1 Vibrio injensis isolate from landfill leachates in southwestern Colombia. Isolates were identified by Matrix-Assisted Laser Desorption/Ionization–Time-Of-Flight (MALDI-TOF), and 16S ribosomal RNA gene sequencing. Analysis of the susceptibility to six antibacterial agents by the Kirby–Bauer method showed susceptibility of all the isolates to ciprofloxacin and imipenem. We recorded resistance to beta-lactams and aminoglycosides, but no multidrug resistance was observed.

pmc-11552072.title: Stable Au(111) Hexagonal Reconstruction Induced by Perchlorinated Nanographene Molecules
pmc-11552072.creator: Antoine Hinaut, Sebastian Scherb, Xuelin Yao, Zhao Liu, Yiming Song, Lucas Moser, Laurent Marot, Klaus Müllen, Thilo Glatzel, Akimitsu Narita, Ernst Meyer
pmc-11552072.description: Surface reconstructions play a crucial role in surface science because of their influence on the adsorption and arrangement of molecules or nanoparticles. On the Au(111) surface, the herringbone reconstruction presents favorable anchoring at the elbow sites, where the highest reactivity is found. In this work, we deposited large organic perchlorinated molecules on a Au(111) surface via high-vacuum electrospray deposition.

pmc-12619291.title: Seawater tides shaped mangrove sediment a bacterial community drastically distinct from supratidal land soil
pmc-12619291.creator: Rufan Zhang, Lu Liu, Yuchen Yang, Shaohua Xu, Ziwen He, Miles E. Tracy, Suhua Shi, Zixiao Guo
pmc-12619291.description: The intertidal zone where mangroves inhabit is unique for both plants and microbes. The periodic seawater tides have allowed only a very small portion of woody plants to shift as mangroves. However, the understanding of how seawater tides shape bacterial community in mangrove sediment is not yet comprehensive.

pmc-12766812.title: CORE-ALI: protocol for a pan-European mixed-methods study to develop a core outcome set for acute lower limb ischaemia
pmc-12766812.creator: Maram Darwish, Lewis Meecham, Leszek Kukulski, Sabrina L M Zwetsloot, Mario D’Oria, Laura Schönherr, Petar Zlatanovic, Vincent Jongkind, Robert Hinchliffe, Florian K Enzmann, Alexander Croo
pmc-12766812.description: BackgroundAcute lower limb ischaemia (ALI) is a life- and limb-threatening vascular emergency requiring urgent intervention. Despite advancements in therapeutic strategies, outcome reporting for ALI remains inconsistent, limiting evidence synthesis and guideline development. The CORE-ALI study aims to develop a Core Outcome Set (COS) to standardise outcome reporting and ensure the inclusion of both clinical and patient-centred metrics.

pmc-12838472.title: Effects of liquid fertilizer and reduced application rate on rice growth, nutrient uptake, and rice yield during the tillering stage
pmc-12838472.creator: Yin Lin, Nai-Jie Feng, Dian-Feng Zheng, Xiao-Le Du, Hang Zhou, Na-Na Yue, Xi-Xi Yang, Ya-Nan Feng
pmc-12838472.description: BackgroundLiquid fertilizer is increasingly used in modern agriculture due to its high solubility and convenient application. However, the regulatory mechanism of liquid fertilizer on rice morphological construction, photosynthetic characteristics, and nutrient uptake during the tillering period is still unclear, and its impact on the final yield formation also needs to be further explored.

pmc-13211636.title: Beyond Antibiotics: The Expanding Role of Non-Antibiotic Therapies in Veterinary Ophthalmology
pmc-13211636.creator: Marta Leiva, Rita Vilao Cardoso, Laura Gaztelu, Teresa Peña
pmc-13211636.description: Simple SummaryThe steady growth of bacterial resistance has encouraged the development of non-antibiotic therapeutic options to limit antibiotic dependence. Among these, topical ocular antiseptics have shown considerable promise as effective and safe agents for both preventive and therapeutic ophthalmic use.

pmc-13413900.title: Untargeted Blubber Metabolomics Reveals Biochemical Signatures Associated with Physiological Status in Live, Free-Ranging Bottlenose Dolphins
pmc-13413900.creator: Makayla A. Guinn, Dara N. Orbach, Hussain Abdulla
pmc-13413900.description: Highlights What are the main findings? Seasonal differences in dolphin blubber metabolites suggest enhanced lipid quality and immune regulation in spring and increased metabolic flexibility and stress-associated responses in summer.Blubber metabolite profiles varied across nearby sites, with two locations exhibiting metabolite profiles consistent with lipid-based energy metabolism and one showing protein turnover pathways suggestive of energetic imbalance.

pmc-13422315.title: Diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers in heart failure and myeloproliferative neoplasms: clinical applications and risk scores – a narrative review
pmc-13422315.creator: Ionela-Raluca Muraretu, Adriana Luminita Gurghean, Adrian Gradinaru, Mircea Bajdechi, Ilinca Savulescu-Fiedler, Anca-Maria Mihailescu, Adriana Mihaela Iliesiu
pmc-13422315.description: Heart failure (HF) remains a leading cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide and frequently coexists with Philadelphia-negative myeloproliferative neoplasms (MPNs), which share thrombo-inflammatory pathways that increase cardiovascular risk. HF is often underestimated in this population, and current risk models rarely include variables specific to this complex cardio-hematologic setting.

pmc-13483952.title: Personalized neoadjuvant treatment regimen selection in locally advanced rectal cancer based on regimen-specific response modeling
pmc-13483952.creator: Xiangyu Liu, Yuanling Tang, Song Zhang, Haiyang Bian, Hanlin Shu, Leen Liao, Xiaolin Pang, Qianting Lv, Jia Chen, Peirong Ding, Ping Liu, Yu Shen, Ziqiang Wang, Shouping Zhu, Jie Tian, Zhenyu Liu, Xin Wang
pmc-13483952.description: Neoadjuvant therapy is standard for locally advanced rectal cancer (LARC), yet regimen selection remains population-based, risking over- or undertreatment. We developed and validated a deep learning framework that provides a generalizable paradigm for data-driven treatment regimen selection by estimating patient-specific probabilities of pathological complete response (pCR) across multiple therapeutic options.

pmc-13538412.title: Chromosome-level genome assembly of a cosmopolitan marine harmful algal bloom diatom species Chaetoceros socialis (Chaetocerotaceae)
pmc-13538412.creator: Zongmei Cui, Nansheng Chen
pmc-13538412.description: Chaetoceros socialis is a cosmopolitan diatom species that is crucial for maintaining marine ecosystem structure and driving elemental cycles. C. socialis can form harmful algal blooms (HABs) that may cause a negative impact on the marine ecosystems. Whole-genome information for C. socialis is still unavailable, which may hinder more targeted studies on its ecological adaptive responses and evolutionary drivers.

pmc-13547227.title: Effect of blended NPSB fertilizer and seeding rates on yield and yield components of bread Wheat (Triticum aestivum L.) in Banja District, Northwestern Ethiopia

pmc-13575950.title: Heterocyclic‐Based Fungicides: Emerging Strategies for Viable Plant Disease Control
pmc-13575950.creator: Sumit Tahlan, Meenakshi Kaira, Sucheta Singh, Hrithik Dey, Kailash C Pandey
pmc-13575950.description: Fungal infections in plants cause significant agricultural losses worldwide, while increasing fungicide resistance and growing environmental concerns have created an urgent need for safer and more effective antifungal agents. Heterocyclic compounds have attracted considerable attention because of their structural diversity, potent antifungal activity, and ability to interact with multiple fungal targets, offering broad‐spectrum protection against phytopathogens.
